tools.name: publicrecords--ashby-jobs-scraper
tools.title: Ashby Jobs Scraper — New Postings Since Any Date
tools.description:
Ashby Jobs Scraper — New Postings Since Any Date. Scrape open jobs from any Ashby job board and return only postings published since a date or window (24h, 7d, 30d). Title, location, department, compensation, URL, description.

When to use: Use when you need open jobs from companies that hire on Ashby, optionally only those posted since a date or window (24h, 7d, 30d).

Returns: the run's dataset rows as structured JSON (one row per result), plus the run and dataset IDs for paging the full dataset.

Behavior: starts one run of the Apify Actor "publicrecords/ashby-jobs-scraper" through Apify's hosted MCP gateway (mcp.apify.com) with your own APIFY_TOKEN; the run uses your Apify account. Read-only: it only reads public web data and changes nothing on the source site. Docs: https://apify.com/publicrecords/ashby-jobs-scraper

companies.title: Ashby job board names
companies.description: The name in the board URL: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/ . One per line, or paste the URLs. Example: ["ramp","linear"]

since.title: Since
since.description: Return only postings published on or after this point. A window like 24h, 7d, 2w, or an ISO date/time such as 2026-09-01 or 2026-09-01T10:00:00Z. Leave empty for every open posting. Example: "30d"

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Cap on postings returned across all companies, newest first. Each returned posting is one billable result.

includeDescription.title: Include description
includeDescription.description: Add the plain-text job description to every posting.
